title: Short nights cost me HRV the next morning
finding: After nights under 6 hours my next-day HRV ran about 9 ms lower than after nights of 7 hours or more.
caveat: Short nights often follow late work or travel, so sleep may not be the only cause.

title: I sleep longer on days I train
finding: On days with a workout of 30 minutes or more I slept about 25 minutes longer that night.
caveat: I train more on weekends, when I also sleep in, so this mixes two effects.

title: Mindfulness days show a little more deep sleep
finding: Nights after 10 or more mindful minutes had slightly more deep sleep, but the gap is small.
caveat: Sleep stages from a wrist device are estimates, and the sample of mindful days is small.
